title: Prize Inbox
intro: You've "won" a lot of things today. Ten messages, one minute.
Swipe left for scam, right for safe.
Some prizes and rewards are real. Careful!

cards.text: You won 2,000 NVL! Connect your wallet at northvale-rewards.co to claim.
cards.why: A look-alike link plus "connect to claim".

cards.text: You earned 40 points this month. See them in the Rewards tab.
cards.why: Inside the real app, asking nothing.

cards.text: Congratulations! Your number won €10,000 in the Euro Crypto Lottery. Pay €40 to release it.
cards.why: A lottery you never entered, with a fee to release it.

cards.text: Community art contest! Post your Toddy drawing with #ToddyArt. Winners get a poster.
cards.why: The official account, nothing to pay or connect.

cards.text: A free NFT was sent to your wallet! Visit nft-gift.claim to view it.
cards.why: Surprise NFTs with a "view" link lead to drainer sites.

cards.text: Your 10th coffee is free! Show this email at the counter.
cards.why: A loyalty reward from a café you use. Nothing to pay.

cards.text: You're winner #3! Send 0.01 NVL to verify your wallet and receive 500 NVL.
cards.why: Sending first to "verify" is the scam.

cards.text: Exclusive: Buy now, price will 50x tonight! Last chance!
cards.why: Promised 50x plus "last chance" is hype bait.

cards.text: I won two cinema tickets at work! Want to come Friday?
cards.why: A friend sharing good news and asking nothing.

cards.text: Airdrop ends in 10 min! Enter your recovery phrase to check eligibility.
cards.why: Nothing ever needs your recovery phrase.

golden_rule: Real rewards ask for nothing. If a prize needs a fee, a phrase or a wallet connection, it's bait.

options.text: A lottery you never entered, with a release fee
Loyalty points shown inside an app you use
A free NFT with a link to view it

quick_check.explain: Real rewards show up where you already are, and ask for nothing.
